    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest_driver AS (
    SELECT driver_id
    FROM turkish_laps
    ORDER BY lap_ms ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM results AS res
     WHERE res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
       AND res.XCL_079 = 1) AS total_wins
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN fastest_driver AS fd ON d.XCL_034 = fd.driver_id

WITH fastest_lap_times AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(T1.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.XCL_088, INSTR(T1.XCL_088, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.XCL_088, '.') - INSTR(T1.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.XCL_088, INSTR(T1.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM results AS T1
    INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.XCL_074 = T2.XCL_065
    WHERE T2.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
      AND T1.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
record_holder AS (
    SELECT driver_id
    FROM fastest_lap_times
    WHERE time_in_seconds = (SELECT MIN(time_in_seconds) FROM fastest_lap_times)
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT T1.XCL_038 || ' ' || T1.XCL_039 AS full_name
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN record_holder AS T2 ON T1.XCL_034 = T2.driver_id
